records.jp: ふう。ひとまず、これで完成？
records.en_original: Phew. I think that does it.
records.en: Phew. I think that does it.

records.jp: どう、詩帆さん？
records.en_original: What do you think, Shiho?
records.en: What do you think, Shiho-san?

records.jp: すごくいい雰囲気です！<CR>ここでコーヒーが飲めると思うと、感動ですね
records.en_original: I love it! I can't wait to enjoy a nice cup of coffee.
records.en: I love it! I can't wait to enjoy a nice cup of coffee.

records.jp: お菓子食べたりするのもいいかもね～
records.en_original: Don't forget all the snacking possibilities!
records.en: Don't forget all the snacking possibilities!

records.jp: じゃあ、早速使ってみよう！
records.en_original: Well, let's use it already!
records.en: Well, let's use it already!

records.jp: なにか用意しましょうか？
records.en_original: Can I get something for you?
records.en: Can I get something for you?

records.jp: さすが元店員。堂に入ってる
records.en_original: Ooh, she's already using her barista experience!
records.en: Ooh, she's already using her barista experience!

records.jp: あれ聞きたいな。<CR>いらっしゃいませーってやつ！
records.en_original: I wanna hear your best barista greeting!
records.en: I wanna hear your best barista greeting!

records.jp: ふふ。いいですよ
records.en_original: Hehe. Sure.
records.en: Hehe. Sure.

records.jp: （いらっしゃいませ、か）
records.en_original: (A greeting...)
records.en: (A greeting...)

records.jp: 実は、バレエの指導を受けるために<CR>この街に来てたんだ
records.en_original: Truth is, I was here for some ballet coaching.
records.en: Truth is, I was here for some ballet coaching.

records.jp: 今日で指導は終わりだから、帰らなくちゃいけない
records.en_original: Today was my last day, so I have to go back home.
records.en: Today was my last day, so I have to go back home.

records.jp: そうだったんだ……
records.en_original: Oh... I see...
records.en: Oh... I see...

records.jp: そんな顔しないで。いつか、また来るから
records.en_original: Aw, don't give me that look. I promise I'll come back.
records.en: Aw, don't give me that look. I promise I'll come back.

records.jp: 続けることを選んだんでしょ？<CR>それなら、またここで会える
records.en_original: We both decided to push through our journeys, didn't we? I know we'll meet here again.
records.en: We both decided to push through our journeys, didn't we? I know we'll meet here again.

records.jp: その時はさ。<CR>いつもみたいに迎えてくれると嬉しいな
records.en_original: And when we do, I hope you'll greet me like you did before.
records.en: And when we do, I hope you'll greet me like you did before.

records.jp: はい。約束します！
records.en_original: I will. I promise!
records.en: I will. I promise!

records.jp: （そう……約束したんだ。<CR>　次に会ったときはあの言葉で迎えるって）
records.en_original: (That's right... I promised. That I would give her a warm welcome when we met again.)
records.en: (That's right... I promised. That I would give her a warm welcome when we met again.)

records.jp: 最後にもう一回聞かせて。<CR>結構好きなんだ。詩帆の出迎えの言葉
records.en_original: I want to hear it one more time. I like how you say it.
records.en: I want to hear it one more time. I like how you say it.

records.jp: はい！
records.en_original: Okay!
records.en: Okay!

records.jp: いらっしゃいませ！
records.en_original: Welcome!
records.en: Welcome!

records.jp: へ？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.en_original: Wha—?!
records.en: Wha—?!

records.jp: あ、あれ？<CR>ごめん、お店に入ったつもりはないんだけど……
records.en_original: H-huh? Sorry, I didn't mean to come in here...
records.en: H-huh? Sorry, I didn't mean to come in here...

records.jp: 日菜子、だよね……？
records.en_original: Hinako... Is that you?
records.en: Hinako... Is that you?

records.jp: えっと、あなたたちは……？
records.en_original: Um... Who are you guys?
records.en: Um... Who are you guys?

records.jp: 記憶がないんだね？
records.en_original: Lost your memory, huh?
records.en: Lost your memory, huh?

records.en_original: How did you...?!
records.en: How did you...?!

records.jp: 私のこと、何か知ってるの……？
records.en_original: Do you know something about me...?
records.en: Do you know something about me...?

records.jp: 少しだけ。伝えられることは少ないけど――
records.en_original: Just a little. We don't know much ourselves, but—
records.en: Just a little. We don't know much ourselves, but—

records.jp: わたしたちに分かる範囲で答えます
records.en_original: We'll tell you everything we can.
records.en: We'll tell you everything we can.

records.jp: みんな記憶が無くて……けど、ココロトープという<CR>場所に行くことで、記憶を取り戻せる……？
records.en_original: So everyone lost their memories... But you can go to this place called a Heartscape to get them back...?
records.en: So everyone lost their memories... But you can go to this place called a Heartscape to get them back...?

records.jp: まあ、いきなり言われても分かんないよね
records.en_original: Hard to believe, right?
records.en: Hard to believe, right?

records.jp: ひとまず、ここにいれば安全だと思う
records.en_original: But you're safe here.
records.en: But you're safe here.

records.jp: ごめんね、わたしたちも<CR>どういうことなのか全然分かってなくて……
records.en_original: Sorry, we couldn't give much information...
records.en: Sorry, we couldn't give much information...

records.jp: ううん、平気。<CR>むしろ、今の方がすっきりしてるかも
records.en_original: No, it's okay. I actually feel a little better now.
records.en: No, it's okay. I actually feel a little better now.

records.jp: ついさっきまで、ずっと寝てるのか起きてるのか<CR>分からないような状態だったから……
records.en_original: Up until now I wasn't sure if I was awake or dreaming...
records.en: Up until now I wasn't sure if I was awake or dreaming...

records.jp: そういえば、わたしもそうでした。<CR>突然意識がはっきりして、そしたら皆さんがいて……
records.en_original: Now that you mention it, that's how I felt too. I suddenly snapped awake, and all of you were there.
records.en: Now that you mention it, that's how I felt too. I suddenly snapped awake, and all of you were there.

records.jp: 寝てるのか起きてるのか分からない状態、か……
records.en_original: Not sure if you're awake or asleep, huh...
records.en: Not sure if you're awake or asleep, huh...

records.jp: それって、私たちの行動の何かがきっかけになって、<CR>詩帆さんや日菜子さんを“起こした”ってこと？
records.en_original: Does that mean that something we did "awakened" Shiho and Hinako?
records.en: Does that mean that something we did "awakened" Shiho-san and Hinako-san?

records.jp: ってことは、愛央のコールドスリープ説が<CR>もしかしたら正しいのかも！？
records.en_original: So Ao's cryostasis theory might've actually been right?!
records.en: So Ao's cryostasis theory might've actually been right?!

records.jp: 少なくとも、普通の日常を送っている人を<CR>連れてきてるわけじゃないんだね
records.en_original: At the very least, we know that we didn't uproot people who were living their normal lives.
records.en: At the very least, we know that we didn't uproot people who were living their normal lives.

records.jp: 良かった……。私たち、一歩間違えたら、<CR>とんでもなく酷いことを繰り返してることになってた
records.en_original: That's a relief. I was worried that one tiny slip-up would end up bringing someone here again.
records.en: That's a relief. I was worried that one tiny slip-up would end up bringing someone here again.

records.jp: 私は普通の日常を送ってたけどね……
records.en_original: I was living my normal life, though...
records.en: I was living my normal life, though...

records.jp: そういえばそうだった。<CR>あれ……つまり……？
records.en_original: Oh yeah, that's true. Wait, so what does that mean?
records.en: Oh yeah, that's true. Wait, so what does that mean?

records.jp: 結局よくわからない、と言うことになりますね……
records.en_original: It means we still don't really know anything.
records.en: It means we still don't really know anything.

records.jp: うーん……
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en: Hmm...

records.jp: まあ、またあとで考えよ。<CR>今は日菜子のことだよ！
records.en_original: Well, we can always think about it later. For now, let's take care of Hinako!
records.en: Well, we can always think about it later. For now, let's take care of Hinako!

records.jp: そうですね。<CR>いろいろ案内してあげないと
records.en_original: Good point. We should show her around.
records.en: Good point. We should show her around.

records.jp: みんな、ありがとう……
records.en_original: Thank you, everyone...
records.en: Thank you, everyone...

records.jp: （いろいろ大変だろうし、<CR>私も日菜子さんに積極的に話しかけてみよう）
records.en_original: (I'm sure she's going through a lot. I should talk to her and try to make her feel comfortable too.)
records.en: (Things must be hard for her. I should make an effort to talk to Hinako-san too.)
